record.reason: Prospective amendment01 reassigned pair05 to the raytrace RTX lane. The original queue completed pairs03-04, observed the raytrace lane's pre-created pair05-r01 attempt, and failed closed before duplicate behavior.

Prospective amendment02 reassigned pair07 to the newly idle nano RTX lane. The already-running pairs06-09 script completed all nine pair06 replicates, observed the nano lane's pre-created pair07-r01 attempt, and failed closed before duplicate behavior.

Prospective amendment03 reassigned pair09 to the original LingBot RTX lane. The Fast-main queue completed pair08, observed the original lane's pre-created pair09-r01 attempt, and failed closed before duplicate behavior.

Prospective amendment04 split pair09 by untouched sampling replicate. The original queue completed r01-r03, observed the atomic no-model r04 reservation, and failed closed before duplicate behavior; the robotwin-expansion lane consumed that reservation only after every release gate passed.

Prospective amendment05 split the remaining pair09 replicates across two untouched lanes. The robotwin-expansion queue completed r04-r06, observed the atomic no-model r07 reservation, and failed closed before duplicate behavior; the original LingBot RTX lane consumed that reservation only after every release gate passed.
